testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Three genuine WeakMap-registered ordinary-input public-inference pilot runs. Every chosen route is safe under every board consistent with observations. Probe results include actual open/wall; manual A submission certifies the public route without revealing unprobed cells.
testProvenance.edgeStates: All canvas states are obtained from original create/step states without mutation. Inputs exercise reveal/open/wall, unknown route, backtrack/mode return, free known repeat at zero, blocked unknown, pre-exhaustion wrong submission, no retroactive strike, cumulative errors after exhaustion, generic unsafe complete route, wrong edge count, timeout, all3wins.
testProvenance.unsafeRoute: The scratch test enumerates only public4x4 simple route geometry and submits each in fresh original rounds until generic unsafe feedback occurs. No true wall mask is read by this harness or fed to the normal pilot; no individual wall is exposed by the art.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Actual menu/start/B-route/P-pause use unmodified model/runtime and original registered states. Terminal/boundary layout frames explicitly replace scratch-served create with a public snapshot and step with no-op. They are layout fixtures only: snapshots cannot restore private WeakMap truth, and no browser-earned-win/APK/device/video claim is made.
testProvenance.readOnly: Deeply frozen public states render unchanged. Throwing getters cover internal underscore fields, hypothetical truth fields, hidden cell properties and every PureModel API read. Changed external time/raw input still yields identical commands/HUD/result. Exact material/question/line/clue assertions bind every case to public observations.
testProvenance.history: The preliminary source review, copy previews and incomplete2ddf full-art attempt remain historical. The2ddf attempt passed render/960 checks but failed1280 tip orphan-line validation; its images/source/report were preserved. All final cases and two-viewport layouts rerun on one stable final game/model/pilot generation; no evidence bridge is used.

independentStaticReview.scope: Read-only public-contract/game/icon source review, no browser claim.
resolvedFindings: Zero-probe unknown selection uses NO PROBES LEFT instead of promising a reveal.
